title: Metadata
description: What names a document, as Kubernetes names an object. Documents refer to one another by `name`.

name.description: The document's name: lower-case letters, digits and `-`, beginning and ending with a letter or digit. It names the document, never the knowledge base.

namespace.description: The Kubernetes namespace the document belongs in. The launcher reads none.

labels.description: Kubernetes labels. The launcher reads none.

annotations.description: Kubernetes annotations. The launcher reads none.
